# Copilot Instructions

When generating or editing UI in this repository, follow the project design system:

- Read [../docs/ai/web-app-design-system.md](../docs/ai/web-app-design-system.md)

## Core Expectations

- Build a modern SaaS-style interface for both public pages and admin panels.
- Use one coherent system across the whole web app.
- Public pages: cleaner storytelling, more spacing, lighter visual density.
- Admin pages: tighter, clearer, more operational, more software-like.
- Use Tailwind + CSS variables and reusable tokens.
- Respect light-first theming, with structured support for dark mode.
- Avoid hard-coded colors, inconsistent spacing, random shadows, or default template aesthetics.

## UX Priorities

- Aesthetics
- Maintainability
- Consistency
- Usability

## Never Do

- Ship stock template UI
- Use purple default gradients without product intent
- Make admin look like a marketing site
- Make public pages feel like CRUD software
- Use overly dark legacy-style sidebars by default
